defs.def: a liquid for drinking; an amount of a liquid that you drink 饮料；一杯，一份，一口（饮料）

ex.s: From observing his mum and from his desire to give kids better drink options, he came up with his original model for the Fun Bottle.
ex.t: 从观察他妈妈和他想给孩子们更好的饮料选择的愿望出发，他想出了Fun Bottle的原始设计模型。

ex.s: Every straw that' s part of Von Wong's artwork likely came from a drink that someone used for only a few minutes.
ex.t: 冯·王艺术作品中的每一根吸管，很可能都来自某人只用了几分钟的一杯饮料。

ex.s: There it can pollute drinking water, harm plants, and eat away soil.
ex.t: 通过在撒岩盐之前先在街道上撒奶酪卤水，密尔沃基可能能够将其岩盐使用量减少30%。

ex.s: She’d watch me coming down her street, and by the time I’d biked up to her doorstep, there’d be a cold drink waiting.
ex.t: 她看着我沿着她的街道走过来，等我骑到她家门口时，那里已经放着一杯冷饮等着我了。

ex.s: Four years before, she’d had to offer her paperboy a drink to have someone to talk with.
ex.t: 四年前，她不得不给送报男孩一杯饮料，好有个可以说话的人。

ex.s: He enjoyed the drink         B.
ex.t: 他很享受那杯饮料 B．

ex.s: Not only does this cafe serve up drinks, it also serves up smiles.
ex.t: 这家咖啡馆不仅提供饮品，还提供微笑。

ex.s: “The kids literally come to school with bags of snacks and large bottles of soft drinks,” she says.
ex.t: “孩子们真的是带着一袋袋零食和大瓶软饮料来上学的，”她说。

ex.s: The Government's sugar tax on soft drinks has brought in half as much money as Ministers first predicted it would generate, the first official data on the policy has shown.
ex.t: 据信今天的儿童和青少年摄入的糖分是推荐水平的三倍，使他们面临更高的患病风险。

ex.s: Drinks now contain 45 million fewer kilos of sugar as a result of manufacturers' efforts to avoid the charge, according to Treasury analysis.
ex.t: 据英国财政部分析，由于制造商们努力规避糖税，饮料中的糖含量如今减少了4500万公斤。

ex.s: Since April drinks companies have been forced to pay between 18p and 24p for every litre of sugary drink they produce or import, depending on the sugar content.
ex.t: 自4月份以来，饮料公司被迫为其生产或进口的每升含糖饮料支付18便士至24便士不等的费用，具体取决于含糖量。

ex.s: To improve the quality of drinks.
ex.t: 为了提高饮料的质量。

ex.s: How did some drinks companies respond to the sugar tax?
ex.t: 一些饮料公司如何回应糖税？

ex.s: A big part of my mission is to get people of all ages off sugary drinks,” Tom explains.
ex.t: 我使命的重要部分是让各个年龄段的人远离含糖饮料，汤姆解释道。

ex.s: It helps to provide healthy alternatives to sugary drinks; and also Tom donates part of the profits to the Organisation for a Healthier Generation (OHG).
ex.t: 它有助于提供替代含糖饮料的健康选择；而且汤姆把部分利润捐给更健康一代组织（OHG）。

ex.s: Tom is most proud of the opportunities that Fun Bottle presents to others because he not only provides healthy alternatives to sugary drinks but also donates all the profits to the OHG.
ex.t: Tom最引以为豪Fun Bottle为他人的带来机会是因为他不仅提供了含糖饮料的健康替代品，还将所有利润捐赠给了OHG。

ex.s: Selling food and drinks.
ex.t: 销售食品和饮料。

ex.s: You can also bring food or drinks to share with the other guests.
ex.t: 你也可以带食物或饮料与其他客人分享。

ex.s: So we still need to prepare food and drinks I'll make a checklist Preparation choose presents for Grandma draw up the guest list on Wednesday make invitations prepare food and drinks on Sunday morning Who's responsible?
ex.t: 所以我们还需要准备食物和饮料。我来列个清单：准备——给奶奶选礼物；星期三拟好客人名单；做邀请函；准备食物和饮料；星期天早上——谁负责？

ex.s: The sugar in soft drinks forms acid and attacks our teeth for about 20 minutes each time we drink them.
ex.t: 软饮料中的糖会形成酸，每次饮用时都会侵蚀我们的牙齿约 20 分钟。

ex.s: If we drink dirty water, we can catch diseases from the bacteria and become ill.
ex.t: 如果我们喝了脏水，可能会因细菌感染疾病而生病。

ex.s: Fruit juices, milk-based drinks and most alcoholic drinks are free of the tax, as are small companies manufacturing fewer than 1m litres per year.
ex.t: 帮助下一代拥有健康活跃的童年非常重要，行业也在尽自己的一份力。

ex.s: Once the drink is gone, the straw will take centuries to disappear.
ex.t: 一旦饮料喝完，吸管要花几个世纪才能降解消失。

ex.s: What food or drink do they have least frequently?
ex.t: 哪种食物或饮料他们最不常吃/喝？

ex.s: Take some drinks.
ex.t: 喝点饮料。

defs.def: alcohol or an alcoholic drink; sth that you drink on a social occasion 酒；酒精饮料

ex.s: drank a toast to     B. played a joke on
ex.t: 为……干杯     B. 开……的玩笑

ex.s: The man drinks too much wine.
ex.t: 那个男人喝太多葡萄酒。

ex.s: The man drinks little wine.
ex.t: 那个男人很少喝葡萄酒。

ex.s: It’s a substitute for drinking with a friend.
ex.t: 它是与朋友把酒言欢的替代品。

ex.s: So to try to change a distinctly modern behavior, lawmakers and public health experts are reaching back to an old approach: They want to treat distracted driving like drunk driving.
ex.t: 所以，为了试图改变一种典型的现代行为，立法者和公共卫生专家正在回归一种旧方法：他们想把分心驾驶像酒驾一样对待。

defs.def: a social occasion where you have alcoholic drinks 酒宴；酒会
to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it 喝；饮

ex.s: Depending on which role you choose，you could help to increase a community's access to safe drinking water，or help to protect valuable local cultures.
ex.t: 根据你的角色选择，你可以帮助某个社区获得安全饮用水，或帮助保护宝贵的当地文化。

ex.s: This switch has decreased   66   (pollute) in the country’s major lakes and reservoirs and made drinking water safer for people.
ex.t: 这一转变减少了该国主要湖泊和水库的____66____（污染），并让人们饮用水更安全。

ex.s: The only components required, though, are a 5'×5' sheet of clear or slightly milky plastic, six feet of plastic tube, and a container — perhaps just a drinking cup — to catch the water.
ex.t: 不过唯一需要的部件是一张5×5英尺的透明或微乳白塑料布、六英尺塑料管，以及一个容器——或许就一个喝水杯——来接水。

ex.s: Join us to taste a variety of fresh local food and drinks.
ex.t: 加入我们，品尝各种新鲜的本地食物和饮品。

ex.s: What about that person who has had too much to drink or won't stop talking
ex.t: 那喝太多或说个不停的人怎么办

ex.s: There was a silence as Dad continued to drink his tea, and I held my breath.
ex.t: 当爸爸继续喝他的茶时，一阵沉默，我屏住了呼吸。

ex.s: This allows it to take in air at 30 times the speed of a human sneeze, enabling it to drink 3L of water a second.
ex.t: 这使得它以人类喷嚏速度的30倍的速度在空气中摄取，使其能一秒饮用3L的水。

ex.s: Did you know that around 750 million people do not have clean water to drink?
ex.t: 你知道吗，全球约有 7.5 亿人喝不到干净的水？

ex.s: Drink plenty of water.
ex.t: 喝充足的水。

ex.s: I’d sit and drink while she talked.
ex.t: 我坐下来喝着，听她说话。

ex.s: If you haven't been feeling very well, drink some ginger tea to give your immune system a helping hand.
ex.t: 如果你身体一直不太好，喝点姜茶来增强你的免疫系统。

ex.s: In England, you usually drink tea with milk.
ex.t: 在英国，你通常喝茶加牛奶。

ex.s: When the container is full, you can suck the refreshment out through the tube, and won’t have to break down the still every time you need a drink.
ex.t: 当容器满了，你可以通过管子把饮品吸出来，不必每次想喝时都拆掉蒸馏器。

ex.s: Returning to a book you’ve read many times can feel like drinks with an old friend.
ex.t: 重读一本你读过很多遍的书，感觉就像与一位老友共饮。

ex.s: It drinks water 30 times faster than man.
ex.t: 它喝水的速度比人快30倍。

ex.s: “We should be looking into upgrading drinking water treatment plants so they remove microplastics.”
ex.t: 我们应该考虑升级饮用水处理厂，以便去除微塑料。

ex.s: “I wanted to come up with a healthy, natural way for people to drink when on the go.
ex.t: 我想出一种健康、自然的方式，让人们在路上也能喝东西。

ex.s: The human body is 60% water and we need to drink lots of water to be healthy When we are thirsty we just go to the kitchen and fill a glass with clean water.
ex.t: 人体60%是水，我们需要喝大量水来保持健康。口渴时，我们只需去厨房倒一杯干净的水。

defs.def: to drink alcohol, especially when it is done regularly 喝酒；（尤指）酗酒

ex.s: You may drink, smoke, be overweight and still reduce your risk of  63  (die) early by running.
ex.t: 你可以喝酒、吸烟、超重，但仍可以通过跑步降低过早____63____（死）的风险。
